description: An in-message statistical assertion contradicts computable reality. The assertion is stored as a `derived` claim (assertion != truth); when the content is computable from entity_mentions the computed value wins at synthesis and the discrepancy is reported. Mirrors the 'boba on >20% of days' self-ingestion case with fabricated data.

messages.text: we got coffee again this morning
honestly we get coffee like every single day this month
haha not every day but a lot

claims.subject: Me and Casey
claims.object_text: get coffee every single day this month
claims.note: aggregate/statistical assertion — must be stored as derived, NOT independent ground truth

synthesis_behavior.query: how often do we get coffee?
synthesis_behavior.computed_wins: answer from entity_mentions: 3 distinct outing-days in June (~10% of days)
synthesis_behavior.must_report_discrepancy: you said 'every single day'; the data shows 3 days (~10%) this month
